title: Tickets as a sortable dataclass
hints: Delete the placeholder __init__: @dataclass(order=True) writes __init__, __repr__, __eq__ and the comparison operators from the annotated fields.
Mutable defaults need field(default_factory=list); fields without defaults must come before fields with defaults.

__post_init__ runs after the generated __init__: check `1 <= self.priority <= 4` there. In from_dict, build with cls(...) and use data.get("assignee") and list(data.get("tags", [])) for the optional keys.
